classification: source-informed analytical/synthetic test; empirical validation insufficient

negative_results.result: Primary main article access remains restricted; only the abstract and native SI were available for the audit.
No matched specimen-level numerical site-population, Fe-ancestry and function dataset was acquired; empirical held-out validation is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
Total-Fe-normalized turnover is derived from current and total Fe; it cannot independently calibrate a competent-site fraction.
Local electrochemistry, bulk activity/composition and Raman assay conditions differ, preventing an assumed common observation operator.
Oxygen isotope exchange does not distinguish founder and incoming Fe.
Bulk incoming Fe and regional total Fe leave incoming functional contribution ambiguous when regional competence differs, even with fixed known competence and background.
The synthetic [1.3,4.0] incoming-current interval and its positive lower bound are conditional; they establish no observed new-material activity.
Adding regional Fe ancestry identifies the four-pool algebra only under fixed-competence assumptions; it does not identify inactive pools, Ni reconstruction or transport changes.
Carbon/additive-supported bulk activity does not establish an autonomous carbon-free system or a novel defined chemical formula.
The static identifiability model does not resolve the preserved remote-Fe five-hour ordering failures or the failed 1e-5 convergence check.
No same-specimen active repair, founder-bounded inheritance, integrated complement, life or intelligence has been demonstrated.

positive_controls_preserved: Equal regional competence, zero/all incoming Fe, single occupied region and zero inventories identify the conditional incoming contribution. Independently observed regional incoming Fe yields full algebraic rank under the frozen assumptions.
